title: Morning DCA run classification block (watchlist scan + live execution)
description: The run_classification object embedded in every MORNING run_state artifact. The morning stream has two modes: a 9:45 AM ET read-only watchlist/early-warning scan (run_type='morning_dca_watchlist_scan', analytics only, trades=false) and a 10:30 AM ET live Robinhood execution (run_type='morning_dca_live', trades=true). Both are INDEPENDENT of the afternoon live task 10ce362c (which supersedes ce16ba6b): stream='morning' and valid_afternoon_evidence=false always, so afternoon slippage/watchdog/weekly reporting never treats a morning artifact as afternoon scheduled evidence. Morning fills count only as prior-allocation context for the afternoon same-day top-up guard. Contains no secrets.

run_origin.description: Origin of the morning run. 'scheduled' is the 9:45 AM ET watchlist scan or the 10:30 AM ET live execution; everything else is 'manual'.

run_type.description: 'morning_dca_watchlist_scan' for the 9:45 AM read-only scan, 'morning_dca_preflight' for the 9:45 AM read-only pre-flight validation that emits eligible_to_execute per ticker, 'morning_dca_live' for the 10:30 AM live execution. Deliberately never the afternoon 'scheduled_live_test'.

stream.description: Stream marker. Always 'morning' so this artifact is never confused with the afternoon stream.

trades.description: false for the watchlist scan (analytics only), true for the live execution. Must agree with run_type.

manual_run.description: true for manual morning runs, false for scheduled morning runs. Must agree with run_origin.

cron_id.description: Morning task id: 'bb4f6ef1' for the 9:45 AM watchlist/pre-flight scan, '42173154' for the 10:30 AM live execution. Distinct from the final live task '10ce362c'. The repo-internal alias 'morning-dca-0945' was retired from the active schedule on 2026-07-27 and is accepted only so artifacts written before then stay valid.

supersedes_cron_id.description: Always null: the morning tasks supersede nothing.

scheduled_for_et.description: Nominal ET fire time, HH:MM. '09:45' (watchlist) or '10:30' (live) for scheduled runs; null for manual runs.

scheduled_window_start_et.description: Inclusive start of the accepted morning window in ET, HH:MM.

scheduled_window_end_et.description: Inclusive end of the accepted morning window in ET, HH:MM.

run_id.description: Unique run id. Watchlist scheduled: 'morning_YYYYMMDD_0945ET'. Live scheduled: 'morning_live_YYYYMMDD_1030ET'. Manual: 'manual_morning[_live]_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSSZ_<suffix>'.

triggered_at_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the run was triggered.

state_schema_version.description: Contract version tag: 'morning-watchlist-v1' for the watchlist scan, 'morning-preflight-v2-machine-complete' for the machine-complete pre-flight validation (see schemas/morning_preflight.schema.json), and 'morning-live-v2-preauthorized' for the 10:30 live execution (the pre-authorized direct-placement contract with raw-data persistence + automatic failure recovery). 'morning-live-v1' is the HISTORICAL/SUPERSEDED live tag retained for backwards compatibility with pre-2026-07-15 artifacts.

valid_afternoon_evidence.description: Always false. A morning artifact is NEVER valid afternoon scheduled-live evidence; it counts only as prior-allocation context for the afternoon same-day top-up guard.

afternoon_live_cron_id.description: The afternoon live task id ('10ce362c') recorded for cross-reference only.

execution_broker.description: The sole execution broker for the morning live streams. Always 'robinhood'.

account_number.description: The Robinhood account number used for morning live execution. Pinned to a shape, not to a literal: the approved account number is supplied by the ROBINHOOD_AGENTIC_ACCOUNT_NUMBER environment variable and is deliberately not committed to this repository. That the run used the APPROVED account is enforced at runtime, not here -- near_close_dca.account_pinning_failure refuses to run live without a configured account, and the morning/midday executor blocks when broker.account_number() does not match it.

preauthorized_direct_place.description: True on scheduled 10:30 live runs: pre-authorized direct placement (no per-order confirmation, no review_equity_order; place_equity_order only after all safeguards pass). False for read-only (watchlist/preflight) and manual runs.

valid_morning_evidence.description: Always true. This schema's stream field is pinned to the const 'morning' above, so every artifact validated against it is a morning-stream artifact and is therefore valid MORNING evidence (and prior-allocation context for the midday/afternoon top-up guard). A midday run_state (stream='midday') is validated against schemas/midday_run_classification.schema.json instead, where MorningDCAExecutor.run_classification's shared implementation sets this same field to false. Morning evidence never counts as afternoon evidence (valid_afternoon_evidence is always false).

trading_day.description: America/New_York trading day (YYYY-MM-DD) this run belongs to. Part of the same-day artifact contract (see config/scheduled_tasks.json:scheduled_run_artifact_contract and scripts/scheduled_artifacts.py).

same_day_required.description: True for scheduled runs: this artifact is only valid as evidence for its own trading_day. False for manual runs.

valid_scheduled_evidence.description: Derived from the completed run_state (run_origin='scheduled' AND manual_run=false), never asserted blindly. See scripts/same_day_pointer.py:derive_valid_scheduled_evidence.

account_pinning_failed.description: True when a trading run could not pin a usable account number (config.target_account_number was unset, the unset placeholder, or not 6-12 digits). Set only on a fail-closed blocked run: placement is refused and account_number is omitted because no valid value exists. Lets a watchdog distinguish 'blocked, account not pinnable' from a malformed or truncated artifact.

allOf.comment: Scheduled pre-flight validation: pinned window and run_id pattern.

Live execution (10:30 AM ET) invariants. state_schema_version is deliberately NOT pinned here (only the top-level enum applies): this branch matches on run_type alone, so it must also accept a HISTORICAL 'morning-live-v1' document re-validated after the fact, not just freshly generated 'morning-live-v2-preauthorized' artifacts. cron_id and trades are stable across both schema versions.
Scheduled watchlist scan: pinned window and run_id pattern.

Scheduled live execution (any version): pinned window and run_id pattern. Deliberately NOT gated on state_schema_version so a HISTORICAL 'morning-live-v1' scheduled document still validates its window/run_id shape. The v2-only preauthorized/evidence fields are required separately below, scoped to 'morning-live-v2-preauthorized' only.

Scheduled live execution (v2-preauthorized only): requires and pins the v2 preauthorized-placement contract fields. Gated on state_schema_version so a historical 'morning-live-v1' scheduled document -- which never emitted these fields -- is NOT required to carry them, preserving backwards-compatible validation.

Live execution ALWAYS requires execution_broker, including a run that fail-closed on account pinning: the broker is known even when the account is not. Kept as its own unconditional rule because folding it into the account_number branch below let a truncated blocked-live classification with no broker validate (Codex review, PR #219).

Live execution additionally requires account_number UNLESS the run fail-closed because no account could be pinned (account_pinning_failed), the one state in which no valid account value exists. watchlist/preflight require neither.

account_pinning_failed and account_number are mutually exclusive. Without this, a document could assert BOTH that no account was pinnable and that a specific account was used: the conditional above merely stops requiring account_number, and the standalone property still accepted one. That ambiguity reached reporting, because _account_number_from() prefers the nested number and ignores the failure marker (Codex review, PR #219).

A run that could not pin an account never placed an order, so it can never be valid scheduled evidence. The builder always ties these together (account_pinning_failure() routes through _blocked_live_result(), which denies scheduled evidence via deny_scheduled_evidence()), but nothing enforced it here: with valid_scheduled_evidence otherwise unconstrained, an artifact from another producer or a corrupted document could assert both account_pinning_failed=true and valid_scheduled_evidence=true, and generate_credit_usage_proxy_report.py's consumer rejects only an explicit false -- an unset or true value would then be counted as valid scheduled evidence for a run that never traded (Codex review, PR #219: "Deny scheduled evidence when account pinning fails", applied here for parity with the midday schema).
Manual runs never use a scheduled run_id and are always manual_run=true.
